caption: The drawing depicts a copper pan with three curved legs and a long, straight handle extending to the right. The pan has a round open shape with a brim slightly rolled outward at the edge. The outside of the pan is rendered in a metallic copper color, with darker brown and reddish-brown shadows to indicate depth and surface reflections. The interior of the pan appears silver or gray, suggesting a different material or a worn copper surface. The three legs are attached to the base, with two visible at the front and side, each curling outward at the foot. The handle is tubular, narrowing slightly at the attachment to the base and becoming wider and flatter toward the end. The composition is centered on a plain light beige or cream background, and the artist’s signature, “Bisby Finley,” appears below the pan.
title: Bishop Hill: Copper Skillet
